proposals.defect: The sticky start route index is no longer passed to the ordering logic, so the next request begins from the original first route (the one that failed) and makes an external call to it again.
The sticky start route is dropped whenever fallback shuffling is enabled, so with shuffle_fallbacks the next request may start from a previously failed route and call it externally.

def _next_attempt_order(
        self, *, settings: EffectiveSettings
    ) -> tuple[ExpandedRoute, ...]:
        """Return route attempt order and advance the round-robin cursor."""
        request_index = self._request_index
        self._request_index += 1
        sticky_start = (
            None
            if settings.shuffle_fallbacks
            else self._sticky_start_route_index
        )
        return ordered_routes(
            self.route_plan,
            options=RouteOrderOptions(
                round_robin_start=settings.round_robin_start,
                shuffle_fallbacks=settings.shuffle_fallbacks,
                min_routes_for_fallback_shuffle=(
                    self.config.policy.min_routes_for_fallback_shuffle
                ),
                request_index=request_index,
                max_attempts=settings.max_attempts,
                selected_start_route_index=sticky_start,
            ),
        )
